generator.dependencies: Python 3 standard library; complete local source intake and repo are required. Does not download or claim a clean clone contains raw sources.

validation.shaMode: Report and control pins freshly hashed. Large candidate files use preserved source-manifest SHA plus fresh size and format/mesh checks; this run does not claim fresh SHA of all asset payloads. All 33 historical mutable-path mismatches freshly hashed and labelled.

limits: No human visual review in this audit. Source names and existing parsed manifests are preserved.
GMO filename-only character identities remain review-required.
Unknown SSBU native identifier groups (including projectiles, bosses, Pokémon and assistants) remain review-required, not confirmed undesigned heroes.
OU99 intentional proxy donor identities remain review-required; borrowedByHeroIds is not an exact mapping.
No design quality or runtime combat assertion is inferred from complete definition files.
Original local LoL corpora and 300/MBA are outside this subagent scope.
